description: Mark paragraph styles as accessible context breaks: their paragraphs export to EPUB as thematic breaks (<hr>), or remove the mark (Layout > Accessible context breaks; Paragraph Style Options > Export Tagging)

exportClass.description: CSS class to give the exported break

remove.description: Remove the context-break mark instead of adding it

styles.description: Paragraph style names, e.g. the style of a "* * *" separator paragraph

name: set_context_break_styles
title: Set Context Break Styles
